[bold #D75FFF]◆ EPIC bob-cli-4w[/bold #D75FFF]
[dim]  Title: [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]bob ref: a reference library for agents and Bryan[/bold #D7AFFF]
[dim]   Goal: [#D7D7AF][/dim]`bob ref` is the canonical command for Bob's reference library. [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]`find`, `list`, and `show` answer "is this already in my library, [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]what am I reading or planning to read, what have I finished, and [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]what did I note?" correctly on the real vault. Each answer comes in[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]beautiful human output, Markdown, or versioned JSON, and is honest [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]about coverage. The six Highlights pipeline verbs work unchanged [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]under `bob ref` and under the permanent `bob highlights` and `bob [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]highlights-ref` aliases. Annotations no longer carry the leaked [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]marker mirror, and a URL that only a legacy note records can be [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]captured again. A deployed `bob_ref` skill makes "check the library[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]first" the default step for agents that recommend reading.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim] Counts: [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]11[dim][/bold #D7AFFF] phases[dim][/dim] · [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]7[dim][/bold #D7AFFF] waves[/dim]

[dim] Prompt: [#87AFFF][/dim]prompts/202610/bob_ref_reference_library.md[/#87AFFF]

[dim]   Page: [#87AFFF][/dim]https://github.com/bobs-org/bob-cli--beads/blob/main/pages/bob-cli-4w/[bold #87AFFF][/#87AFFF]README.md[/bold #87AFFF]
[dim]  1 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Promote bob ref to the canonical command[/bold #D7AFFF]                      [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]rename[dim] · [dim][/dim]no dependencies[/#AF87FF][/dim]

    [#D7D7AF]`highlights` and `highlights-ref` aliases, grouped help, canonical [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]diagnostics, completion paths, fixtures, docs, and alias-equivalence [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]tests.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  2 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Managed-region and note-anatomy parser[/bold #D7AFFF]                        [bold black on #87D7FF] small  [/bold black on #87D7FF]
    [#AF87FF]region[dim] · [dim][/dim]no dependencies[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]region: a read-only parser for rendered ref-note bodies (annotation [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]blocks with quote and comment kept apart, tombstones, mirror and [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]preamble detection, the user's own notes, and the Tasks section), [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]round-tripped against the renderer.[/#D7D7AF]
